pages.text: Its creatures are made of antimatter like everything else there. $(thing)Annihilators$() are shells around a core of $(item)antihelium$(); $(thing)Positronium Skitterers$() eat antisilicon; $(thing)Antihydrogen Wisps$() drift over the sea and drop frozen antihydrogen.
$(thing)Annihilator$(). Lives in: The Antiverse.$(br)Drops: Antiquark Shard, Antihelium Nucleus.
$(thing)Positronium Skitterer$(). Lives in: The Antiverse.$(br)Drops: Antisilicon Shard, Antiquark Shard.
$(thing)Antihydrogen Wisp$(). Lives in: The Antiverse.$(br)Drops: Antihydrogen Crystal.
